description: This PHP source file defines the DatabaseBackupService class within the OrangeHRM HRMS system. The class provides functionalities for creating, restoring, and deleting database savepoints using cache mechanisms and direct database operations, specifically tailored for testing scenarios.

classes.name: DatabaseBackupService
classes.description: Service class managing database savepoints for testing purposes, including creation, restoration, and deletion, utilizing cache storage and direct database commands.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Retrieves the Doctrine database connection via EntityManager.

methods.name: getSchemaManager
methods.description: Gets the schema manager to list database tables.

methods.name: getCache
methods.description: Returns the cache adapter used for storing savepoint data.

methods.name: genSavepointCacheKeyPrefix
methods.description: Generates cache key prefix for savepoints based on savepoint name.

methods.name: genSavepointCacheKey
methods.description: Generates full cache key for a specific savepoint and table.

methods.name: createSavepoint
methods.description: Creates a savepoint with given name, storing current table data in cache.

methods.name: createInitialSavepoint
methods.description: Creates an initial savepoint, clearing previous savepoints.

methods.name: _createSavepoint
methods.description: Internal method that performs the savepoint creation for all tables.

methods.name: restoreToSavepoint
methods.description: Restores database to a named savepoint state using cached data.

methods.name: restoreToInitialSavepoint
methods.description: Restores database to initial savepoint state, clearing cache.

methods.name: _restoreToSavepoint
methods.description: Internal method that restores data from cache back into the database for all tables.

methods.name: deleteSavepoint
methods.description: Deletes a named savepoint from cache.

methods.name: deleteSavepoints
methods.description: Deletes multiple savepoints or all savepoints if no names provided.

methods.name: _deleteSavepoint
methods.description: Internal method that clears cache entries for a savepoint prefix.

methods.name: deleteAllSavepoints
methods.description: Clears all savepoints including initial savepoint.
